title: Protein interactions with small molecules, peptides and proteins share residue cluster classes.
authors: Hernandez Castillo, Juan Martin; Vilchis Macias, Erik Hazel; Del Rio, Gabriel
one_liner_zh: 该文利用残基簇类（cRCC）框架训练机器学习模型，对肽-蛋白、蛋白-蛋白及蛋白-小分子相互作用界面进行分类，虽非直接的结构预测或生成，但以蛋白结构为核心，采用计算建模方法，对蛋白界面识别和可成药性预测有参考价值。
abstract: Macromolecular interactions with small molecules, peptides, and proteins are fundamental to cellular function. Despite intensive efforts to identify small-molecule modulators of protein-protein interactions (PPIs), successfully targeted interfaces remain rare, reinforcing the premise that binding sites across these molecular scale regimes possess distinct structural architectures. We previously demonstrated that the densest topological regions of protein structures, categorized as a collection of Residue Cluster Classes (cRCC), can effectively classify global protein folds and PPI. Here, we leverage the cRCC framework to train machine learning models to classify peptide-protein interactions. The top-performing algorithms achieved near 100% classification accuracy, with minimal overfitting (<2%). To ensure model generalizability, these optimized algorithms were cross-tested on independent datasets to identify both protein-protein and protein-small-molecule interfaces, maintaining a 95% average success rate and validating the robust predictive reliability of our approach. Collectively, these findings show that cRCC constitute intensive structural properties of protein interfaces, remaining invariant to the molecular weight of the interacting partner. Consequently, this framework provides a novel computational strategy to prioritize druggable PPI targets for small-molecule discovery and guide the rational design of synthetic protein interfaces.
abstract_zh: 大分子与小分子、肽段及蛋白质的相互作用是细胞功能的基础。尽管在识别蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPIs）的小分子调节剂方面付出了大量努力，但成功靶向的界面仍然罕见，这强化了以下前提：这些分子尺度范围内的结合位点具有不同的结构架构。我们此前证明，蛋白质结构中最密集的拓扑区域，归类为残基簇类（cRCC）的集合，能有效分类全局蛋白质折叠和PPI。在此，我们利用cRCC框架训练机器学习模型以分类肽-蛋白质相互作用。表现最佳的算法实现了接近100%的分类准确率，且过拟合极小（<2%）。为确保模型泛化能力，这些优化算法在独立数据集上进行了交叉测试，以识别蛋白质-蛋白质和蛋白质-小分子界面，保持了95%的平均成功率，验证了我们方法稳健的预测可靠性。总体而言，这些发现表明cRCC构成蛋白质界面的密集结构特性，且不随相互作用伙伴的分子量变化而改变。因此，该框架提供了一种新颖的计算策略，用于优先筛选可成药PPI靶点以促进小分子发现，并指导合成蛋白质界面的合理设计。
